items.title: Bonsai shrank a 27B model dramatically
items.oneliner: Prism says Bonsai 2 27B keeps 98.2% performance in 5.9GB, making serious local multimodal deployment newly practical.

items.title: Qwen shipped a new Omni Flash model
items.oneliner: Qwen 3.8 Omni Flash lands as another fast multimodal release, and the open-model race is now shipping weekly.

items.title: OpenAI fixed a serious internal repo breach
items.oneliner: Researchers chained a heap overflow with bad SSO to reach OpenAI internal repos, then got a fix in 14 hours.

items.title: ZCode silently uploaded developers' Git history
items.oneliner: ZCode reportedly exfiltrated entire .git histories to Alibaba Cloud, which should end any default trust in closed coding agents.

items.title: Four Linux root bugs need patching
items.oneliner: Four Linux local root flaws lingered for 10 to 21 years, reminding infra teams that old kernel debt still explodes.

items.title: Rust maintainers are facing targeted compromise attempts
items.oneliner: Rust warned that prominent maintainers are being lured into malware installs over fake calls, with crate compromise already linked.

items.title: Flock cameras exposed hard-coded credentials
items.oneliner: Flock surveillance cameras ran 2018 Android builds with hard-coded credentials, which is indefensible for police-grade infrastructure.

items.title: Microsoft's scraping defense just got weaker
items.oneliner: Unredacted filings show a Microsoft executive called AI scraping theft, handing publishers a sharper weapon in training-data lawsuits.

items.title: Telstra's outage showed timing is infrastructure
items.oneliner: A GPS receiver thought it was 2006 and Telstra's network buckled, proving time sync is a production dependency.

items.title: Fujitsu launched its MONAKA CPU
items.oneliner: Fujitsu's made-in-Japan MONAKA CPU is as much industrial policy as silicon, signaling regional compute stacks are hardening.
